# File reference

The `scripts/docsgen` generator writes this page from the source code. Do not edit this page. To update it, run `make docs-generate`.

This page lists the files and directories that Starport can use with the default configuration. A path that starts with `~` is in your home directory. A setting in the Selectors column can move the path. Starport creates only the files that the selected backend and operation use. To see the report for your configuration, run `starport config paths --files`.
